facts.fact: ICTworks' directory lists Burkina Faso's Plan Stratégique de la Santé Numérique (PSSN) 2025-2029 as the operative instrument, signed in January 2025, and says the instruments adopted by Burkina Faso and six neighbours in 2023-2025 share an EHR component alongside an interoperability layer, telemedicine, a governance pillar and costed implementation; it names no EHR product and gives no deployment.

note: Regional directory; the only Burkina Faso content is the strategy's name, period and adoption date, and a group statement on what seven countries' strategies contain.
